Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He pauses for a bit, as if ashamed to ask his next question.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: But tell me, please, if you have any suggestions for improving my ... reach, is the word.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I wish to welcome as many of us as I can, because no one else will.

Line.Text: Have you not seen one of mes drapeaux-- one of my flags waving at you as you walk up the branch below?

Choices.Text: Is that all there is to you? Being French and roleplaying as a greeter for the newcomers?
I only noticed these banners around your home. I don't think that they're visible from the lower level.
